answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The thread edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 48 clones produces a signature the mesa analysis flags immediately. A hostile operator must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the umber settlement applies the void retroactively. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
